rationale: The round-4 positions remain substantively incompatible on the core issues: labour and state still reject closures/forced redundancies, while management, owners, and investors still insist these must remain available absent a proven equivalent. The debate has converged only on the need for quantified comparison, but no side has moved materially toward the other, so further rounds are likely to keep circling unless the process is tightened or benchmarked externally.
